recommended_npk_ratio: 120:60:60 kg N:P2O5:K2O per hectare (Irrigated Bt Cotton); 60:30:30 for Rainfed.
basal_dose: Apply 100% of Phosphorus (Single Super Phosphate / DAP) and 50% of Potassium (MOP), plus 20% of Nitrogen at final land preparation / sowing.

top_dressing_splits.nutrient: 30% Nitrogen (Urea) + 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate (if soil is deficient)
Remaining 20% Nitrogen as top dressing or foliar spray of 19:19:19 @ 1% or Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) @ 1% to arrest square shedding

micronutrients_and_organic: Apply 10 tonnes Farm Yard Manure (FYM) or 2.5 tonnes vermicompost per hectare. Foliar spray of Magnesium Sulphate (1%) and Boron (0.1%) during boll formation reduces leaf reddening and improves boll weight.
key_warning: Avoid excess Nitrogen during vegetative stage as it promotes vegetative rank growth, attracts sucking pests (jassids, whiteflies), and delays maturity.

recommended_npk_ratio: Olitorius (Tossa): 60:30:30 kg N:P2O5:K2O per ha; Capsularis (White): 80:40:40 kg/ha.
basal_dose: Apply all P2O5 (SSP) and all K2O (MOP) plus 25% of Nitrogen at the time of final ploughing. If soil pH is below 5.5, apply agricultural lime @ 2 to 4 quintals/ha 20 days before sowing.

top_dressing_splits.timing: 3 to 4 weeks after sowing (First weeding & thinning)
6 to 7 weeks after sowing (Rapid elongation stage)
top_dressing_splits.nutrient: Remaining 25% Nitrogen (Urea @ 8-10 kg/acre) applied after rain or light irrigation

micronutrients_and_organic: Incorporate well-decomposed FYM @ 5-7 tonnes/ha. In acidic laterite soils, foliar spray of 0.2% Borax prevents terminal bud necrosis.
key_warning: Never apply Urea on dry soil or in bright midday sun. Apply after weeding and rake into topsoil.

recommended_npk_ratio: Hybrids: 180:120:150 kg N:P2O5:K2O per hectare; Open Pollinated: 100:60:60 kg/ha.
basal_dose: Apply 50% Nitrogen, 100% Phosphorus, and 50% Potassium along with 25 tonnes FYM and 25 kg Zinc Sulphate per hectare before planting.

top_dressing_splits.timing: 25 to 30 days after transplanting (Vegetative / Early flower)
50 to 60 days after transplanting (Fruit setting & sizing)

fertigation_option: Under drip fertigation, feed water-soluble fertilizers (WSF 19:19:19, 12:61:00, 13:0:45) twice a week according to crop stage.
micronutrients_and_organic: Spray Calcium Chloride @ 0.5% or Calcium Nitrate during fruit sizing to avoid Blossom End Rot (BER). Spray Boron @ 0.1% to improve fruit firmness and prevent cracking.
key_warning: Imbalanced Nitrogen without Calcium causes severe blossom end rot (black sunken fruit bottoms).

recommended_npk_ratio: 120:60:40 kg N:P2O5:K2O per hectare (Irrigated Timely Sown); 150:60:40 for high-yielding varieties.
basal_dose: Apply 50% Nitrogen (approx 65 kg Urea/ha), 100% Phosphorus (130 kg DAP or 375 kg SSP), and 100% Potash (65 kg MOP) at sowing through seed-cum-fertilizer drill below seed level.

top_dressing_splits.timing: First Irrigation at 21-25 DAS (Crown Root Initiation stage)
top_dressing_splits.nutrient: 25% Nitrogen (Urea @ 65 kg/ha) just before or immediately after first irrigation

top_dressing_splits.timing: Second Irrigation at 40-45 DAS (Tillering / Jointing stage)

micronutrients_and_organic: If soil is Zinc-deficient, apply 25 kg Zinc Sulphate (21% Zn) as basal per ha or foliar spray 0.5% ZnSO4 + 2.5% Urea at tillering.
key_warning: Do not apply third dose of Nitrogen after earhead emergence as it causes severe crop lodging and increases grain shattering.

recommended_npk_ratio: Medium duration varieties: 120:60:60 kg N:P2O5:K2O per hectare; Hybrids: 150:75:75 kg/ha.
basal_dose: Apply 50% Nitrogen, 100% Phosphorus, and 50% Potash into puddle mud before final levelling.

top_dressing_splits.timing: Panicle Initiation stage (45-50 days after transplanting)

micronutrients_and_organic: Apply Neem-coated urea to enhance nitrogen use efficiency by 15-20%. Apply 25 kg Zinc Sulphate heptahydrate per hectare at puddling. Use Azospirillum and Phosphobacteria biofertilizers.
key_warning: Drain standing water before top dressing urea and re-irrigate after 24 to 48 hours to minimize ammonia volatilization.
